page_title: BIL 1-1 GRA | Athletic Bilbao v Granada CF 19/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates with a free kick, but the defence is well positioned and clears the ball away from danger.

90+8' Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Iglesias Villanueva has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Free kick. Ath Bilbao will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+5' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) duly receives a yellow card.
90+5' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
90+5' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
90+4' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Ath Bilbao are going to take it.
90+1' Today's match ends for Carlos Neva who will be replaced by Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF).
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Ernesto Valverde Tejedor, then shows him a yellow.
90' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.

89' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
87' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
86' The resulting corner from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is cleared by the defence.

86' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Now Ath Bilbao have a corner.
85' The corner from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is hurriedly cleared.
85' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao win a corner kick.
83' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) replacing Gorka Guruzeta.
82' Half-chance! Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) plays a pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla reacts well to snuff out the attack.
81' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Faitout Maouassa comes onto the pitch to replace him.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Matias Arezo (Granada CF) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Boye.
80' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

79' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Augusto Batalla pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
79' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Inaki Williams, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
78' Wonderful movement by Ath Bilbao. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
76' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
76' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Ath Bilbao win a corner.
74' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
73' 64:36 – the ratio of ball possession.
70' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) suffers an injury and Inigo Lekue comes on.
69' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
67' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) picks up an injury.
66' Yellow card. Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
65' Substitution. Antonio Puertas is replaced by Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF).
64' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
63' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
63' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Unai Gomez is replaced by Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao).
63' Substitution. Oihan Sancet makes way for Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).

62' A snap shot by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Augusto Batalla produces a good save to thwart him. The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
61' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
61' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Granada CF have a corner.
60' The attendance for today's match is 45917.
59' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
58' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
58' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

58' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Ath Bilbao will have a corner.
56' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
55' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle. Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul after dangerous play. Granada CF have a free kick.

55' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
54' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

54' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

52' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Oihan Sancet was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
51' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
50' The ball is cleared after Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball has crossed the sideline. Ath Bilbao are taking a throw-in.

49' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches wide of the left-hand post.

49' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Ath Bilbao, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
48' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
47' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
46' The game is over for Gonzalo Villar. Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) comes on for the second half.
46' That's the end of the game for Aitor Paredes, who is replaced by Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+6' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Unai Simon, who smothers the ball.
45+5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF).
45+4' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Granada CF can continue in their attacking effort.
45+4' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+4' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+1' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

44' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) plays a one-two with Nico Williams, but the move breaks down.
44' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
43' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Granada CF will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
43' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
42' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Granada CF.
40' 4:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
39' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Augusto Batalla intercepts the ball.
38' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) attempts to discuss the decision with Javier Iglesias Villanueva, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
36' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
34' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

34' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
32' A raking crossfield pass from Carlos Neva (Granada CF) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
31' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
30' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
27' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
27' Javier Iglesias Villanueva sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!

26' The Ath Bilbao players halt their celebrations as referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
24' 1 - 1 Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) finds his way to a high rebound and doesn't hesitate to blast it into the roof of the net.
24' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
22' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.

21' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it low towards the middle of the target, but Augusto Batalla pulled off a nice save and to stop the attempt.
21' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
19' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
17' A rebound falls to Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
17' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
17' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

16' Augusto Batalla makes a good save! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
14' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
14' A cross into the box from Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) is cleared.
13' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) is able to continue to play.
11' Looks like Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
11' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
10' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) delivers a cross into the box from the free kick, but the effort is over-hit and the ball goes out of play.
9' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick.
6' 0 - 1 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), who heads the corner kick behind his own keeper. The score is 0:1.
6' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) will take a corner kick.
